title: Youngest five students
statementMd:
The five youngest students by birth date (most recent birth date first). Break ties by name.

Expected columns: `name`, `birth_date`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, birth_date FROM students ORDER BY birth_date DESC, name LIMIT 5;
```
